items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: and Sonny Greer on drums and I forgot the name of the piano player, I forgot the trumpet player, but I had those people to make a combination.

ctx.x: And something else I wanted to tell you about. Now, pick up on this one. Now, I'm in New York and Buck is in jail and while he's in jail I've got to worry about how I'm going to pay my bills. I ain't making no money. So I decided -- No, a guy saw me billed in a club, a little speakeasy like on 44th Street downtown, 42nd Street or something -- 43rd Street or 44th -- maybe 46th Street -- saw me billed on a little club with a little revue consisting of about four entertainers and myself

and Sonny Greer on drums and I forgot the name of the piano player, I forgot the trumpet player, but I had those people to make a combination. And I was entertaining in this club and he saw it billed and he's in Germany. He's booking acts for Special Service. After he sees me he says if I was over there I could go in a picture. He writes me a letter and tells me. I don't know who he is. I just think he's another agent. If I'm over there, I could go in a picture. And he wanted to know if I'd come and he stated the…

So I thought that would be good. I'd only be gone a week, 10 days at the most. I'll go and come back. And I went in 1945 -- I think it was right after Bill died, 1951 or '52 -- 1952, '53. it took five years to come back. I come back in 1950 something -- '57 I came back. I went over there --
